note: Decision scope (D231, D233, and D231 rounding correction; replaces D209 row in main catalogue, moving D209 to sensitivity D140). Written on 2026-11-15 by an AI session to follow D231 and D233 of issue #77 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893254289) and the correction to D231 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893360747), taken by the orchestrating AI session under the delegation of D161. Following executive sign-off, that row moves to the sensitivity catalogue of D140. Load one stage set for wheat only: these records share id and scope with the D209 row. WHAT IS LOCAL: the end of this stage, sowing to heading at La Estanzuela, sowing period 1, intermediate cycle, 16 campaigns 2010-2025: 116.5 days (unrounded 116.537; campaign means 111.3-121.5). Heading is «50 % de las espigas totalmente emergidas» (sheet «INICIO», row 30). WHAT IS TRANSFERRED: the start of this stage, day 20, the initial length of FAO-56 Table 11, row «Winter Wheat | December | Calif., USA» (chapter 6, https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e0b.htm); that record is already signed by D209 and is not duplicated here. WHAT IS CHOSEN: ending the development stage at heading (D231). FAO-56 chapter 5 places effective full cover, for many crops, «at the initiation of flowering»; no source read maps heading to that boundary for wheat. Heading is probably a late bound; the D209 row's day 80 is an early one. ARITHMETIC: 116.54 rounds to 117 at the nearest whole day (the correction to D231 rounds every stage length to the nearest whole day); 117 - 20 = 97. Stage set 20 + 97 + 31 + 13 = 161 days. D233: rows are selected by trial code containing «LE1», not by location alone; 109 rows labelled La Estanzuela belong to the 2014 trials at Young (Excel rows 2112-2220) and are excluded. EP3 requires whole days (engine/water/stages.py). Values are cited; the file is not redistributed.
